THE PROBLEM
Agents Are Easy to Demo and Hard to Run.
Processes crash, prompts get ignored, and nobody can say why the agent did what it did.
PlatformCon Sydney 2026
THE IDEA
The Model Proposes. The Platform Decides.
Durable
Every LLM turn and tool call is a recorded task that survives crashes and restarts.
Governed
Guardrails live in the platform, not in the prompt, so they hold every time.
Composable
Agents and workflows run on one engine and can call each other.
PlatformCon Sydney 2026

PlatformCon Sydney 2026
LAB 1 · 10 MIN
A Plain Workflow
WHAT YOU DO
lab1.json
Paste the workflow into Developer Edition and run it twice: 3 hours into the incident, then 1 hour in.
TAKEAWAY
Deterministic logic belongs in a workflow: same input, same path, every run visible.
PlatformCon Sydney 2026
LAB 2 · 12 MIN
PizzaOps as an Agent
WHAT YOU DO
python lab2.py
PizzaOps looks up the team, budget and menus, and plans an order.
TAKEAWAY
An agent is a workflow too: every LLM turn and tool call is a task you can inspect.
PlatformCon Sydney 2026
LAB 3 · 10 MIN
Guardrails
WHAT YOU DO
python lab3.py
Place an order, then ask PizzaOps to get Sam a Hawaiian for his birthday.
TAKEAWAY
Rules live outside the prompt: the guardrail stops pineapple however it’s asked.
Swap pineapple for “never deploy on Fridays” and it’s a platform policy.
PlatformCon Sydney 2026
LAB 4 · 7 MIN
Bring Your LangGraph Agent
WHAT YOU DO
python lab4.py
A standard LangGraph agent with the same tools and three Conductor lines.
TAKEAWAY
Bring the agents you already have: they get the same durability and visibility.
